Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about time zone conversion

How does the time zone converter work?

Simply select your source time zone, enter the time you want to convert, and choose your target time zone. The converter instantly shows you the equivalent time in your destination, accounting for time zone differences and DST.

Does it handle Daylight Saving Time (DST)?

Yes! Our converter automatically adjusts for DST in all regions. The displayed times reflect the correct local time, whether DST is active or not.

What time zones are supported?

We support all major time zones from UTC-11 to UTC+14, including half-hour offsets like India (UTC+5:30) and Nepal (UTC+5:45).

Can I see the date in the converted time?

Absolutely! The converter shows both the time AND date for your target location, so you always know if you're looking at today or tomorrow.

How accurate is the conversion?

Our converter uses your device's system time combined with the IANA timezone database for maximum accuracy. All conversions are updated in real-time.

Can I convert between any two cities?

Yes! Use the dropdown menus to select any two time zones from our database. You can also click on popular city shortcuts for quick conversions.
